utterances.speaker: JUDGE LUI
utterances.text: Good morning, ladies and gentlemen. First of all, may I have the appearances, please. For the Prosecution first.

utterances.speaker: MS. BRADY
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Helen Brady appearing on behalf of the Prosecution, with Nicole Lewis and our case manager, Ms. Lourdes Galicia.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LUI
utterances.text: Thank you very much. And for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. JOVANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. My name is Zoran Jovanovic, attorney-at-law, appearing on behalf of the accused, Dragan Zelenovic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LUI
utterances.text: You may sit down, please. Well, Mr. Zelenovic, can you follow the proceedings in a language that you could understand?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LUI
utterances.text: Thank you. If there's any problem, please let me know. You may sit down now. This is a Status Conference in accordance with the Rule 65 bis. The purposes of this Status Conference are to allow the appellant to express concerns relating to the appeal, detention conditions, and his health, and also to update the appellant with respect of the status of the case. As for the proceeding of this case, the Defence filed a Defence notice for leave to appeal the sentencing judgement on the 27th April 2007. In the Scheduling Order of 24th July 2007, the pre-appeal Judge confirmed that this filing constitute the notice of appeal required under Rule 108 of the Rules. The Defence filed their Defence appeal of sentencing judgement on 25 May 2007. The Prosecution response brief was filed confidentially on the 25th June 2007; the public version was filed on the 3rd July 2007. The Defence reply to Prosecution response brief was filed on the 3rd July 2007; therefore, the pleadings are complete. Of course there is still one pending motion, that is Prosecution's motion to strike portions of appellant's reply was filed confidentially on the 18th July 2007, and the Defence response to Prosecution's motion to strike portions of appellant's reply was filed confidentially on the 31st July 2007. The decision concerning with this motion is being prepared and will be rendered in the due course. Mrs. Brady, are there any matters that you would like to bring to the attention of me?

utterances.speaker: MS. BRADY
utterances.text: No, nothing on behalf of the Prosecution, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LUI
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Jovanovic, how about on your part?

utterances.speaker: MR. JOVANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, Your Honour, the Defence has no issues to address at this Status Conference. As to the health status of the accused, Mr. Dragan Zelenovic, he is still not well, but these are the health problems pointed out by the Defence previously and the Detention Unit's physician submitted its own report during the proceedings. Therefore, there are no news regarding that and there are no other issues on the part of the Defence at this moment. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LUI
utterances.text: Well, what do you mean that his health is not so well and -- has he been taken care of?

utterances.speaker: MR. JOVANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour. During the trial, the Defence was in permanent contact with the physician of the Detention Unit because of the health problems. A report was produced by that physician introduced to the Trial Chamber and the problems mentioned in that report remain. However, he has received appropriate care and we have no objections as to the care he has been receiving at the Detention Unit.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LUI
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Zelenovic, do you have anything to complain during your detention?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LUI
utterances.text: How about your health?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Well, it is not well. I am taking my medication and all, but it doesn't seem to be helping. I'm still being taken to the Bronovo Hospital for testing.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LUI
utterances.text: Well, I believe that you have to take care by yourself during these, you know, proceedings and if there's any problems, please do not hesitate to let the doctors know about it.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LUI
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Well, at this stage it is too early to predict when we'll hold an appeal hearing, but it will be held in the not-too-distant future. In the event the Appeals Chamber will inform the parties once it is sure of the exact date. Are there any other matters that the parties would like to say at this moment?

utterances.speaker: MS. BRADY
utterances.text: No, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LUI
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. JOVANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LUI
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Well, I believe that's all for this Status Conference and the hearing is adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LUI
utterances.text: adjourned at 8.06 a.m.
